text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Uniting as one for Acting Director 
Kashimoto, Little Cocon and the others 
finally shattered their target time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's in considerably better 
shape compared to before...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, Race 5 of the Aoharu Cup! The day 
of the decisive showdown against Team <First> has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though intimidated by Team First, Taiki 
Shuttle and the others are determined to 
challenge them with all their might and 
win. With the start of the race drawing 
near—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"<HOP CHEERS>... Fight, oh!" She pumped 
herself up with a spirited cheer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Hareno-hi Runners... fight on!" And with 
that, they psyched themselves up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"<Carrot Pudding>... Fight, oh!" She 
pumped herself up with a spirited cheer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Blooms... fight on!" And with that, they 
psyched themselves up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Team Carrots... Fight-oh!" they cheered, 
pumping themselves up.
